answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 27803 Country: Bangladesh Title: I saw a dream that i am reading ayat ul qudsi n i was afraid in the dream n i felt smthing is coming but what that is not clear. 2nd dream saw my husband..he was standing besides a pond nd one dead body was laid besides him bt he couldnt recognize..after that he saw a man who is bad told by the few people and they were waiting for my husbands order to kill that man..my husband said kill him nd they did it..then he was walking along with the pond nd saw 2 deadbody in the middle of the pond but he again failed to recognize who they r..please reply soon.thank you. Question: I saw a dream that i am reading ayat ul qudsi n i was afraid in the dream n i felt smthing is coming but what that is not clear. 2nd dream saw my husband..he was standing besides a pond nd one dead body was laid besides him bt he couldnt recognize..after that he saw a man who is bad told by the few people and they were waiting for my husbands order to kill that man..my husband said kill him nd they did it..then he was walking along with the pond nd saw 2 deadbody in the middle of the pond but he again failed to recognize who they r..please reply soon.thank you..ALLAH HAFIZ Answer ID: 27803 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1736/1331/D=1431) (1) It was the feeling of departing the devil and arrival of light and blessing. It does not matter. In future though you have such feeling or not’ you should not pay any attention towards any thing and carry out reciting the Ayatul Kursi as usual. (2) In the second dream, you are warned that in order to protect yourself from the devil and nafs, the eternal enemies of man, it is necessary for you to carry on doing good deeds and shunning from the evils, so that the influence of nafs and devil is gone with the sake of the light of good deeds and you get the wealth of steadfastness on good deeds. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
